# wowsims links (11 November 2026)

The final set of each spec, with enchants and consumables (the "Both" column of README.md). The full wowsims test raid buffs and debuffs, a level 63 boss, 2 min. Open a link, then select Simulate. The DPS values come from wowsims master commit `3633d376a` (11 November 2026). A later wowsims version can give a different DPS.

| Spec | DPS (3633d376a) | Link |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fury Warrior | 946.2 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/warrior/dps/#) |
| Demonology Warlock | 940.3 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/warlock/dps/#) |
| Hunter | 919.8 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/hunter/dps/#) |
| Fire Mage | 915.5 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/mage/dps/#) |
| Combat Rogue | 767.0 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/rogue/dps/#) |
| Retribution | 843.5 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/paladin/retribution/#) |

`zzlink_main.go` makes these links (copy to `cmd/zzlink/main.go`). It also decodes each link and runs it again as a check. The check on commit 3633d376a gives the same values ±0.1%.

The links of 9 November (commit 9f254e8d8) had the sets of `sets_9f254e8d8/`. The search of 11 November changed the sets of the five pure specs. The Retribution set does not change (README.md).

The links of 8 November (commit ae9b8c23a) had the sets of `sets_ae9b8c23a/`. The search of 9 November changed the sets of the five pure specs. The Retribution set does not change (README.md).

The links of 6 November (commit df57e2571) had the sets of `sets_df57e2571/`. The search of 8 November changed the sets of all six specs (README.md).

The links of 4 November (commit 8298ab833) had the sets of `sets_9a8624af9/`. The search of 6 November changed the sets of the five pure specs (README.md).

The links of 2 November (commit 895cd67f9) had the same items. Only the consumables changed: the shared elixir list takes the elixirs of the new Warlock preset.
- **Short links.** `sets/` at the root of the repository has one page for each set. Each page opens the wowsims link: https://ralgathor.github.io/forever-paladin-feedback/sets/
